senses.gloss:
सजन स-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, having men or
living beings; (अस्), m. a man of the same family,
kinsman.

1. सज्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, fastening on clothes, dress-
ing, preparing, putting on armour, arming; (अम्),
n. the act of preparing or making ready; a guard,
sentry, picket; a ferry, Ghāt; (आ), f. the act of
dressing; dress, decoration, equipment, accoutre-
ment, caparisoning an elephant, arming.
सज्जन 2. सज्-जन. See under सत्, p. 1052.

स-जनपद, अस्, आ, अम्, having the same
country; a fellow-countryman.

स-जनामात्य (˚न-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, accompa-
nied by men and ministers.
सजनीय, अम्, n., N. of an ancient hymn.

सजन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to kinsmen
or relations.

सजम्बाल स-जम्बाल, अस्, आ, अम्, having
mud, muddy, clayey.

सजल स-जल, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing or
containing water, watery, wet, humid.
—सजल-
त्व, अम्, n. wateriness.
—सजल-नयन, अस्, आ,
अम्, watery-eyed.

सजात स-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born together,
born at the same time; (अस्), m., Ved. a brother.
—सजात-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. loving one's brethren,
attached to relations or kindred.

स-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of the same sort or kind or
species, of the same class or tribe or caste; (इस्), m.
the son of a man and woman of the same caste.

सजात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being of the same race
or family, a kinsman, relation; (अम्), n., Ved.
brotherhood, relationship; kinsfolk.

साजात्य साजात्य, अम्, n. (fr. स-जाति), com-
munity of genus, homogeneousness, sameness of class
or caste or tribe, equality of kind.

सजार स-जार, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by
a lover, together with a paramour.

सजित्वन् स-जित्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. conquer-
ing common enemies (Sāy. = समान-शत्रु-जय-
शील, समान-जेतृ), conquering together, victorious.

सजिष्णु स-जिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, accompanied
by Arjuna.
सजीव स-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, having life, alive.

सजुष् स-जुष् or स-जुस्, ऊस्, ऊस्, ऊस् (fr. rt.
1. जुष् with स), having fondness or friendship,
loving, serving, attached to; associated together;
an associate, companion; (ऊस्), ind. (thought by
some to be for an original सजूःषु, Visarga being
dropped), with, together with (with inst.).

स-जोष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. rejoicing together, pleased
together, associated through fondness, united.

स-जोषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. associated together,
united with (with inst.), united in love or as com-
panions, loving.

सज्ज् 1. सज्ज् (also written सञ्च्, सञ्ज्),
cl. 1. P. A. सज्जति, -ते, &c., to go, move.

सज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, clothed, dressed;
accoutred, trimmed; ornamented, decorated, pre-
pared, made ready; armed, fortified; (आ), f. dress;
decoration; apparatus, equipment, equipage, harness,
armour, mail.
—सज्ज-कर्मन्, अ, n. the work of
fitting or fastening on, making ready, dressing, pre-
paration.
—सज्ज-ता, f. the being prepared or made
ready, readiness.
—सज्जी-करण, अम्, n. the act of
equipping, arraying, preparing, decorating, arming.
—सज्जी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to equip, make ready, prepare, array; to decorate,
arm.
—सज्जी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, arrayed; prepared;
decorated, armed.
—सज्जी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
-भवितुम्, to become equipped or accoutred or
decorated; to be prepared or made ready.
—सज्जी-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, equipped; prepared, made ready;
decorated.
—सज्जी-भूय, ind. having become pre-
pared or decorated, in full decoration.

सज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, dressing, making ready,
preparing, arming; hesitating (in speech).

सज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, dressed; decorated, orna-
mented; made ready, equipped, accoutred, armed.

सज्य स-ज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bow-string,
strung (as a bow).
—सज्य-सायक, अस्, आ, अम्,
having arrows on the string (said of a bow).

सज्योतिस् स-ज्योतिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, having the
same light, having a common light; (इस्), n. the
time during which the sun or the stars give light.

स-ज्योत्स्ना, f. ‘having moonlight,’ scil. रात्रि, a
moonlight night.
